description: For fixed supplied compilers of \(\psi\), choose a fixed standard index \(q_N\) by uniform self-reference for the first-probe rule. Its first-probe selector is \(n(e,H)=s(q_N,\langle e,\operatorname{code}(H)\rangle)\). The chosen \(q_N\) is independent of \(e\), \(H\), and runtime input.
